summary: Turn-based three-depth dungeon roguelite with selectable threat tiers, behavioral elites and boss phases, classes, telegraphed enemies, loot/inventory, NPC forge and Oracle bargains, fogged automap/grid, first-person/isometric view, field guide/AP hover preview and persistent mastery.
useWhen: Compose Cinder Vault's threat-tiered turn-based dungeon rules with replaceable resource/action/clock/objective/progression/inventory providers and separate content/HUD packs.
limitations: Threats are three broad start-of-run tiers, not a full unlockable ascension ladder; no mid-run difficulty switch.
Camera mode is a presentation-only CameraRole/ViewModes composition; gameplay remains first-person-equivalent in simulation and aiming.

Each depth is a generated static seed; encounters, loot, NPC services, boons and class mastery vary by attempt, not layout. Items/gear/weapons/boons reset with the run; class mastery, best threat and legacy persist via optional profile.
NPC dialogue is a small fixed service hub, the map is a fixed 2D canvas with no pan/zoom, and crafting has no discovery/failure/skill system.
Shooter-family authority with one generated three-wing dungeon and one arena tile theme; no runtime map replacement or run save/restore.
